main.description: The home gallery: every indexed artwork by an actor the viewer Ratat-follows, newest first. Served from the local index alone, so an artist who is followed but not yet backfilled contributes nothing until they are. [public]

viewer.description: DID or handle whose net.ratat.graph.follow records build the timeline.

page.description: 1-based page number. The index is ordered, so a page is an offset; a page past the end of the timeline yields the last page.
The page this response holds. Lower than the requested `page` when the timeline ended first.

total.description: Artworks in the whole timeline, which is what sizes the pager.
